content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Software stripe

Stripe provides a streamlined payment processing service that integrates well with various platforms, but only operates in 46 countries. PayPal's platform is similarly restricted, with account suspensions potentially locking funds for up to 180 days. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy offer eCommerce solutions for digital creators but similarly exclude many countries, limiting access for potential sellers. COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure, however, allows creators in restricted regions to establish fully operational online stores without the need for these conventional payment processors, ensuring autonomy and ownership.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe’s limited geographical footprint effectively excludes a majority of the global population, leaving creators in 149 countries without access. PayPal's account restrictions can impose additional burdens, causing operational disruptions. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy follow suit, preventing many creators from monetizing their digital products. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators to bypass these barriers entirely, providing a reliable framework to operate without being tied to any single platform. This architecture offers true independence from location-based limitations.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe typically charges between 2.9% + 30¢ per transaction, with funds often held for several days before availability. PayPal's fee structure can vary, but account suspensions can immobilize funds, creating uncertainty in cash flow. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy also impose transaction fees that add up over time. With COREMERCH's NOWPayments at a mere 0.5% fee and instant crypto transaction confirmations, creators gain immediate access to their earnings. Moreover, using low-cost networks such as BSC or Solana allows transactions to occur at less than $0.10, ensuring that creators retain more of their profits.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure offers true ownership of your digital sales.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

A significant downside to platforms like Stripe and PayPal is that creators do not own their customer data or product infrastructure. Account control can be taken away at any moment, leading to loss of access to vital sales channels. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy similarly retain control over transactions and customer data. In contrast, with COREMERCH's setup, creators truly own their entire stack, from hosting on platforms like Cloudflare to payment processing with NOWPayments. This ownership extends to data, ensuring that creators have full control over their business operations without interference or fear of account restrictions.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators in restricted countries, leveraging sovereign commerce infrastructure is essential. If you need a quick setup for a few products, the Sovereign Starter Stack is a solid choice. However, if you're looking for a more comprehensive solution that supports more products and offers advanced configurations, the Edge Commerce Stack is ideal. Deployed in just 48 hours, it includes essential features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for reliable email delivery and end-to-end testing before handoff, ensuring a smooth launch for your digital products.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Avoid platform restrictions and account suspensions with COREMERCH.

This stack deploys in 48 hours, providing a solid foundation for selling software in restricted markets. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
